chunks: And with this chain of narration, from Ali ibn Abi Talib (peace be upon him) who said:

Indeed, Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn were playing near the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) until most of the night had passed. Then he said to them: 'Go back to your mother.' A flash of lightning occurred, and it continued to shine for them until they entered to Fatima, while the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) was looking at the flash. He said: 'Praise be to God who honored us, the People of the House.'

key_terms.الْبَرْقَة: A flash of lightning or divine light

ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the light accompanying Al-Hasan and Al-Husayn in this narration?
ai.summary: This narration from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida* highlights the intimate domestic life of the Prophet with his grandsons, emphasizing the divine favor bestowed upon the Ahl al-Bayt through a miraculous light guiding them to Fatima. It underscores the concept of *Ismah* (infallibility) and spiritual purity inherent in the Prophet's household, a theme central to Shia theology regarding their unique status. The event serves as a tangible sign of God's honor (*Ikram*) for the family of the Prophet, reinforcing their elevated spiritual rank.
